breakdown.description: The prescribed global horizontal point load is projected onto the local normal direction of the skew boundary
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeated the error from the incomplete prompt. It explicitly projects the -5 kN horizontal load onto the local normal direction of the left skew boundary, computing F_normal = dot(F_applied, n)*n and applying components (-3461.5, 2307.7) N. The ground truth requires applying the point load directly as a horizontal force (-5000, 0) N at point (1.1, 0.15) without any projection onto a boundary normal.
